card.title: Help, Me, Please
card.tagline: Apprenez à demander de l'aide avec politesse.

song.title: Help Me Please
song.description: Une chanson douce pour apprendre à demander de l'aide avec courtoisie.
lyrics: Help me, help me, help me please,
Help me, help me, help me please,
Gentle hands will help me grow.
A quiet voice, a gentle plea,
Help me please, just help me, please.
Help me, help me, hand in hand,
Help me, help me, help me please,
Help me, help me, help me please,
Gentle hands will help me grow.
